MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH DISTINCT p, t,
  CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH p, t,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR (t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons' AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
WITH p, COLLECT(t.team_name) AS team_names,
  2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^([0-9]{4})/', 1) AS INT64)
  - CASE WHEN CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) > 10
      OR (CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) = 10
          AND CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]+/([0-9]+)', 1) AS INT64) > 14)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (age < 42 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) <= 1)
   OR ('Detroit Pistons' IN team_names AND p.college = 'Temple University')
RETURN p.college AS col1, age AS col2, p.position AS col3, p.name AS name_player
